wolves_fight_sword.name: Wolf Pack Attack
wolves_fight_sword.description: A pack of wolves surrounds you in the forest.

turnText.turn-1: Tutorial: Select cards by clicking them. Selected cards show a number indicating play order. You need enough Focus to play cards - check the focus cost icons on each card.
turnText.turn-2: Tutorial: Right-click cards to discard them (they won't be played but will be removed from your hand). This helps you get rid of unwanted cards.
turnText.turn-3: Tutorial: Synergies boost damage! Play cards with matching affinities together: Fire+Water, Water+Thunder, Thunder+Fire, or Light+Dark pairs give +20% damage each.
turnText.turn-4: Tutorial: Advanced synergies: 3 cards of the same element = +50% damage. All 5 elements (Fire, Water, Thunder, Light, Dark) = +100% damage. 5 Normal cards = +120% damage!

enemy.name: Wolf Pack
enemy.description: A group of hungry wolves with sharp teeth and claws.
